Yes — please go ahead and build it. Everything we've walked through matches what I wanted, and honestly it's grown into exactly the personal library I was hoping for when I described my messy pile at the start. I'm confident in this scope, so you have my go-ahead to build it out properly.

Two things I want to note for *later*, not to hold up building now — I'm happy for this round to be what you've listed:

- Back when we talked about pages sometimes disappearing, you agreed my saved title, labels, and note would stay safe. That's good, but the thing still quietly nagging me is the *content* — sometimes a page vanishes for good and my note isn't enough. Someday I'd love it to quietly keep a copy of the page itself when I save it, so I could still read it even if the original's gone. Just park that as a future wish.
- And since I've fallen a bit in love with the search and filters — one day it'd be handy to *save* a particular search I keep redoing, so I can jump back to it without rebuilding it each time.

Neither of those is for now — build what we've agreed. Just wanted them on record so they're not forgotten down the line. Go ahead.
